invariants.name: no hardcoded game values
invariants.diagnosis: A game value was inlined instead of read from the version registry. A bare 'minecraft:' namespace prefix under construction is a legitimate exception; a named item or entity is not.

invariants.name: no version-number comparisons
invariants.diagnosis: Serializers must branch on traits, never on version numbers.

invariants.name: no literal hex
invariants.diagnosis: Add a token; never inline or approximate with a nearby one.

invariants.name: no literal px
invariants.diagnosis: Add a token; never inline or approximate with a nearby one.

generated.diagnosis: Either a generated file was hand-edited, or a generator change was committed without its regenerated output.
